test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

P _ _ S H _ B K _ H P B _ S _ P B _ _ H
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: P _ _ S H _ B K _ H P B _ S _ P B _ _ H

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

**Option 1) BKPSKHKS **→ P __**B**__ __**K**__ S H / __**P**__ B K __**S**__ H / P B __**K**__ S __**H**__ / P B __**K**__ __**S**__ H

Option 2) BKPSKSKS → P __B__ __K__ S H / <
